tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address. The link should sign the user in when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user clicks the login link, then they are signed in successfully.

tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for the one-time login link. The template should include a clear call-to-action and branding.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then an email with a valid link is sent to the user.

tasks.description: Implement session token expiration after a period of inactivity. The expiration time should be configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is inactive for the expiration time, when the user attempts to access a protected resource, then they are signed out.

tasks.description: Ensure the login flow is accessible, mobile-friendly, and localized. This includes proper semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and translated text.
acceptance_criteria: Given a screen reader, when the user navigates the login flow, then the flow is accessible and readable.

tasks.description: Implement a feature flag to control the rollout of the new authentication system. The flag should allow for a percentage-based rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Given the feature flag is enabled, when a user attempts to log in, then the new authentication system is used.

tasks.description: Collect metrics on login success rate and time-to-login. The metrics should be stored in a database for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user logs in successfully, when the metrics are collected, then the success rate and time-to-login are updated in the database.

tasks.description: Implement validation for the one-time login link. The link should be validated on the server-side to prevent tampering.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid login link, when the user attempts to log in, then an error message is displayed.

tasks.description: Write documentation for the new authentication system. The documentation should include setup instructions, API documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
acceptance_criteria: Given a developer, when they read the documentation, then they can implement the authentication system successfully.

tasks.description: Migrate existing users to the new authentication system. The migration should be done in a way that minimizes downtime and user disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing user, when the migration is complete, then the user can log in successfully using the new authentication system.
